name: HDR Remodeling

gbp_reviews_visible.text: We chose to work with HDR to bring to life a wonderful design that added character to our lovely but minimalist home. HDR was organized, thoughtful and easy to work with. That organization and their desire to please was consistent …

HDR was truly an amazing company to partner with on our home addition project. They were on time, on schedule, and on budget - super rare in this space. The design is exactly what we envisioned and couldn't have been better, and the build team executed it to spec. The addition is top quality and we are so thrilled with it!

HDR helped us remodel our kitchen and two bathrooms. They were extremely professional and responsive throughout the whole process and did a beautiful job. They are a design-build firm meaning that they handle everything in-house - they …

decision_maker.name: Chris Fellows
decision_maker.quote: Chris Fellows is the President of HDR Remodeling.

assessment: Opinion: a long-running East Bay design-build firm whose homepage leads with kitchens and baths, with a named President, a public mailto and steady blog and Pinterest activity. It also sells ADUs and landscape design-build, so the coordinator may weigh the niche fit.
